name: sergod-store-web-v1
description: Sergod Store Web V1 — repositorio operativo CURRENT

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@sergod/foundation && npm run build --workspace=@sergod/contracts
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@sergod/api && npm run build --workspace=@sergod/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@sergod/foundation && npm run typecheck --workspace=@sergod/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@sergod/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@sergod/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:application: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project application
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project integration
scripts.test:contract: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project contract
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:web: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project web
scripts.test:integration:local: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project integration --exclude "**/*remote.integration.test.ts"
scripts.codex:prepare: npm run codex:validate && npm run codex:migrations:verify && npm run codex:index
